scripts.dev: npm run docker:dev && npm run db:migrate && npm run dev:all
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && python -m alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "backend,celery-worker,celery-beat,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:celery-worker" "npm run dev:celery-beat" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && python -m granian --interface asgi --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload app.main:app
scripts.dev:celery-worker: cd backend && python -m celery -A app.tasks.celery_app worker --loglevel=info --pool=solo
scripts.dev:celery-beat: cd backend && python -m celery -A app.tasks.celery_app beat --loglevel=info
scripts.docker:dev: docker-compose up -d postgres pgbouncer dragonfly flaresolverr
scripts.docker:reset: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose up -d postgres pgbouncer dragonfly flaresolverr
scripts.clean: npm run docker:down && rm -rf frontend/node_modules frontend/.next backend/venv backend/__pycache__
